facts.text: Chad is a landlocked country in Central Africa.
The Lakes of Ounianga include eighteen desert lakes supplied by groundwater.
The Ennedi Massif is a sandstone plateau shaped into canyons and natural arches.

culture.text: Paintings and engravings on rocks in Ennedi record human life in the Sahara.

food.name: Boule
food.text: This staple is made from millet, sorghum or maize and served with sauces.
